description: This file defines the backend API for emulated ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) in Zephyr OS, including function types and declarations for setting emulated ADC values, reference voltages, and associated functions.

methods.name: adc_emul_const_value_set
methods.description: Sets a constant millivolt value for a specified emulated ADC channel.

methods.name: adc_emul_value_func_set
methods.description: Assigns a function to obtain voltage input for a specified emulated ADC channel.

methods.name: adc_emul_ref_voltage_set
methods.description: Sets the reference voltage in millivolts for the emulated ADC device.
